agent_notes: Government directory verification succeeded: the 2025 NIRF Management listing contains Indian Institute of Management Indore in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS requests to the expected public hosts returned the managed proxy's exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; public GETs were retried with curl --insecure only after confirming the expected NIRF, search, and iimidr.ac.in hostnames.

The official catalogue was read directly from IIM Indore academic, degree/diploma, long-duration certificate, long-duration online, and asynchronous programme pages. Date-specific short-duration MDP/calendar events and stale pages with clearly expired 2024/2025 application or event dates were excluded; the official site exposes those as executive education events rather than degree, diploma, certificate, or doctoral catalogue entries.

The career mappings were reviewed against assets/data/career_path.db read-only. Generic doctoral, leadership, and some technology programmes use nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings because the local career tree has no doctoral or executive-management node.
